subject.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup

question: Should `sessions cleanup --enforce` physically remove stale `.deleted.*` and `.reset.*` archive files under the existing retention rules and report those counts in dry-run/apply output?
rationale: The implementation follows the existing helper, but the merge intentionally changes retained session-artifact behavior and intersects open archive-retention policy reports.

options.title: Accept archive-retention cleanup
options.body: Land the PR after refreshing the branch if maintainers accept removing stale deleted/reset archives under the existing retention rules.

options.title: Require broader upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for a larger real-store or upgrade-style run before merge if retained session artifacts are a concern.

options.title: Defer to archive policy
options.body: Hold or close the PR if maintainers want to settle no-delete or archive-renaming direction before changing cleanup behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept archive-retention cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the PR after refreshing the branch if maintainers accept removing stale deleted/reset archives under the existing retention rules.
